name: Project XI
summary: Project XI is a free-to-play football (soccer) game playable in the browser and on iOS and Android, with progress saved to the player’s account. It combines several modes. Career is a club management mode played season after season, with transfers, tactics, live match coaching, youth players, a national team, board objectives and press conferences. My Legend is a player career mode that follows a footballer from age 16 to retirement, with matches seen from the player’s view, mini-games, transfers and life choices. The game also includes card drafts, online matches against other players, a card collection, and AI-driven press interviews where players type or speak their own answers.
